description: This file defines the RouteEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and provides implementations for methods related to executing and handling service calls within the Apache OFBiz framework. It primarily manages synchronization and callback mechanisms for services

classes.name: RouteEngine
classes.description: A class responsible for executing and managing service calls in the OFBiz framework, extending the generic asynchronous engine.

methods.name: RouteEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RouteEngine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a synchronous service call and returns a validated set of output parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service without returning any result or output, ignoring the output parameters.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Handles callback invocation after service execution, with different overloads for passing result or exceptions.
